title: Contract
description: Validates the content of a contract artifact. Defines dimension-agnostic criteria that make done executable or attested without privileging behavior as the pipeline spine.

work_unit.description: Common envelope - threads to work unit.

id.description: Stable criterion identifier used by completion evidence.

dimension.description: Open dimension name, such as behavior, documentation, or code-quality.

acceptance_criterion.description: Source for this contract criterion: numbered work-unit acceptance criterion or explicit body-ground obligation.

statement.description: Concrete definition of done for this dimension and criterion.

hollow_delivery.description: A delivery that would appear plausible but fail this criterion.

check.description: Descriptor for the check that verifies this criterion.
